name: bollinger_squeeze_breakout
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, micro-consolidation periods lasting 1-3 minutes produce a measurable Bollinger Band width compression (2-minute rolling std at session lows) as institutional algorithms pause directional flow and resting limit orders accumulate on both sides of the range. When price breaks above the upper band on a simultaneous volume spike, net buy-side order flow has absorbed the accumulated sell-side resting orders at the squeeze ceiling. This initiates a stop-cascade above the range (stops placed by participants who shorted the squeeze boundary) and VWAP-chasing algorithms pile in, producing a 10-20 NIFTY spot-point directional move in the subsequent 30-90 seconds before the momentum exhausts.

indicators.name: sma_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute SMA as Bollinger mid-line. 24 bars (2 min) chosen because micro-consolidations on NIFTY that resolve into 30-90s breakouts typically compress over 1-3 minutes. Shorter (12 bars) is too noisy; longer (60 bars) misses the intraday micro-squeeze context.

indicators.name: bb_width_24
indicators.purpose: Normalized band width = (upper - lower) / mid = 4 * rolling_std / sma. At NIFTY ~22000, threshold 0.0015 means 4*std < 33 pts, i.e., std < 8 pts per 5s bar — characteristic of a quiet 2-minute consolidation. The 24-bar window matches the hold time so the squeeze preceding the trade is visible at the same resolution.

indicators.name: upper_bb_24
indicators.purpose: Upper Bollinger Band (2 sigma). Breakout above this signals bullish squeeze release.

indicators.name: lower_bb_24
indicators.purpose: Lower Bollinger Band (2 sigma). Breakdown below this signals bearish squeeze release.

indicators.name: vol_ratio_24
indicators.purpose: Volume relative to its own 2-minute mean. Index volume on NIFTY spikes 1.5-2x during breakout bars vs the quiet accumulation phase. This filters false breakouts caused by stochastic price drift rather than genuine order-flow imbalance.

conditions: close > upper_bb_24 — price just broke above the squeeze ceiling
vol_ratio_24 >= vol_ratio_threshold (default 1.5) — volume confirming the breakout
buy_ce.confirmation: All three conditions must be true on the same 5s bar. The simultaneous squeeze + breakout fires at the first bar where the compression is visibly releasing — before subsequent bars widen the band.

conditions: close < lower_bb_24 — price just broke below the squeeze floor
vol_ratio_24 >= vol_ratio_threshold (default 1.5) — volume confirming the breakdown
buy_pe.confirmation: Mirror of buy_ce. Bearish squeeze releases happen when resting buy orders are absorbed.

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points (~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). If a genuine squeeze breakout retraces 8 spot points back into the squeeze range, the thesis has failed — the break was absorbed. NIFTY micro-consolidation breakouts should not retrace more than 8 spot pts within 60 seconds if real institutional follow-through is present. Using half the expected move as the stop gives 1:1.75 R:R.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points (~14 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). The initial directional leg from a 2-minute squeeze breakout on NIFTY extends 12-20 spot points in 30-90 seconds before the first pullback. Targeting 14 spot points captures the conservative end of this range, ensuring high win probability on the initial impulse leg rather than waiting for full continuation.

filters.vix_filter: none — squeeze breakout is structural and not VIX-regime dependent at 5-second resolution
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST — skip first 10 minutes of session (pre-open noise and initial volatility settling)
filters.trend_filter: none — squeeze resolves in either direction; strategy is symmetric
filters.spread_filter: none — NIFTY is ultra-liquid, limit orders execute at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — Bollinger Squeeze is widely known; but at 5-second resolution the pattern is less crowded than on 1-minute bars

adaptation_notes: Original held 30-100 minutes on 1-min equity bars (nifty100 stocks). Converted to NIFTY index at 5-second bars with 30-120 second holds. Key changes: (1) Lookback compressed from 20 minutes to 2 minutes (24 bars) to match the intraday micro-consolidation timescale — the thesis is the same but the compression window must match hold time. (2) Volume filter is relative to 2-min mean rather than prev-bar comparison, more robust on index volume. (3) Keltner Channel removed — it added noise on the original but for 5s index we only need the BB width threshold directly. (4) Stops/targets in option points calibrated to 30-90s NIFTY move magnitudes, not the original's ATR(20) on equity. (5) Trailing stop removed — too complex for 30-120s option holds, fixed stop/target only.
weaknesses: Squeeze on 2-minute window may still be inside a larger trend move — no higher-timeframe filter means some breakouts go against the dominant session direction
NIFTY volume data at 5-second resolution can be sparse/zero during low-activity periods, making vol_ratio unreliable — strategy may miss some valid breakouts
False breakouts (price crosses band then immediately reverts) are the primary failure mode; the volume filter helps but does not eliminate them
At session open (09:15-09:25 filtered out) the most volatile breakouts occur — filtering this window reduces trade count but misses high-magnitude moves
